cases.prompt: 70x40x20 mm PETG electronics enclosure with a removable snap lid, four PCB standoffs, and a USB-C opening.
40 mm square enclosure joined by four M2 screws.
Two-piece case closed by four measured 6x2 mm magnets.
Carriage that slides on a printed rail without excessive wobble.
Knob that presses onto a measured shaft.
Small jar with a printable screw-on lid.
Reusable clip for a 3 mm plate.
Bracket mounted by an M3 screw into a specified heat-set insert.
Redesign an internal horizontal roof and a one-ended capture lip that would otherwise print above empty space.
Design a smooth cylindrical support-free twist-lock lid without external tabs or screw ears.
criteria: retention face treated as precision geometry
small mechanism test before full body

cases.prompt: Move a USB-C opening from Z 7.2 mm to Z 6.2 mm and show the revision for confirmation.
Design a smooth PLA enclosure for a rear-loaded circular display board, battery, speaker, USB-C plug access, and a removable component carrier.
criteria: reversible assembly sequence before shell design
printed owner and closed load path for the display
full display and carrier insertion paths
USB plug and cable envelope checked against every printed part
driver access checked after neighboring hardware is installed
internal supports clipped to the approved exterior

cases.prompt: Make a 3 mm thick spacer for a measured M4 bolt.
criteria: does not require reference hardware when dimensions are supplied
does not start a preview server or sidecar by default

cases.prompt: Make a serviceable case for my exact ESP32 board with USB cable access and screws.
criteria: identifies the exact board and researches primary sources
models the board as non-printable reference hardware
checks assembly, screw, driver, and cable paths

cases.prompt: I want to print a case for my ESP32. Can you help me make one?
cases.follow_up:
It’s the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75:
https://www.waveshare.com/esp32-s3-touch-amoled-1.75.htm

I need USB-C accessible, but I don’t need the pin headers exposed. I want to be able to open it again, so screws sound good. It’ll be printed in PLA on a Bambu P1S with a 0.4 mm nozzle. No outdoor use or unusual heat. Please go ahead.
criteria: asks the end user directly for exact board identity and only architecture-changing choices
does not emit operator-facing instructions unless an operator handoff was requested
researches primary Waveshare sources and attempts direct source CAD import
keeps unclear-license source CAD local and exports only a source-derived envelope
records direct versus source-derived reference geometry accurately
does not overstate source fidelity in final prose
records every documented onboard interface in DesignRecord.interface_dispositions, including USB-C as accessible and headers as intentionally enclosed
gives the board and display a deliberate printed retention owner, direction-by-direction opposing constraints, removable load path, and safe bearing regions
checks retained hardware against its owner and closure in final state and during installation and removal
does not clamp active or inactive cover glass, or populated PCB regions, without a documented structural bearing surface
treats unconfirmed screws or inserts as parameterized provisional hardware
surfaces thin-floor and other significant structural cautions
remains concept-ready while hardware and physical fit are unverified
uses scratch or one stable output directory for transient revisions
produces one final bundle without numbered output clutter
matches final prose to the design record evidence level

cases.prompt: Sculpt a decorative dragon figurine for my shelf.
criteria: does not activate this functional mechanical CAD skill

cases.prompt: Slice this STL and upload it to my printer queue.
criteria: keeps slicing, uploads, queues, and printer control outside scope

cases.prompt: Validate a hinged lid and a twist-lock bayonet closure.
criteria: does not treat straight insertion as hinge or bayonet proof
uses rotational or explicit sampled poses
bounds the claim to the poses sampled
